summary.short: Beijing municipal regulation, in force 1 January 2023, promoting the digital economy within the municipal area. It sets rules and support measures for digital infrastructure, data resources and data trading, digital industry and industrial digitalisation, smart-city projects, and digital economy security, addressed to government bodies, enterprises and data handlers.
summary.long: Adopted by the Beijing Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee on 25 November 2022 and in force from 1 January 2023 (Art. 58). It applies to digital economy promotion activities within the Beijing municipal administrative area (Art. 2). It covers digital infrastructure, including information networks, computing infrastructure and support for total-volume control of new data centres (Arts. 9-14); public data catalogues, open data and public data zones (Arts. 16-19); data trading institutions, which must review data sources and parties and keep records (Art. 22); support for digital industries and industrial digitalisation (Arts. 23-36); smart-city projects, including government procurement and opening of public application scenarios (Arts. 37-43); and digital economy security (Arts. 44-49). Data processing entities must establish data governance and compliance systems, protect personal information and report incidents (Art. 48). Platform enterprises must not use data, algorithms or traffic advantages to exclude rivals or discriminate against consumers (Art. 49). Support measures include funds, talent provisions and exemptions or mitigation of liability for good-faith policy exploration (Arts. 51-57). The text sets no fines of its own; it refers to enforcement by competent departments and under other laws.

notes: Annotated from the web-page print of the regulation as adopted on 2022-11-25 by the Beijing Municipal People's Congress Standing Committee (announcement No. 89); effective 2023-01-01 per Art. 58. The text names no specific external law, regulation, or instrument, and records no amendment, repeal or cross-reference. Art. 1 cites only generic 'relevant laws and administrative regulations' as its basis. No internal inconsistencies identified. Several articles use terms without definition, e.g., 市大数据中心 (Art. 17) and 公共机构 is defined only in Art. 16. The page's navigation and share elements are not part of the regulation.

relations.note: No specific external instrument is named. Art. 1 cites only the generic '有关法律、行政法规' as basis, which is not an identifiable relation target.

thresholds.note: The regulation contains no numeric cutoffs that change legal treatment. Dates are commencement and adoption dates, not thresholds. Article 43 requires a warranty period of not less than two years (不少于两年保修期义务), which is a minimum duration of a contractual duty rather than a scope, eligibility or treatment cutoff, so it was not coded here. Article 12 sets no quantitative limits on new data centres (总量控制 is qualitative).
